decisions.sourceSet: User-confirmed four 1103 locale databases; former card-catalog audit is historical background
decisions.englishMissingIds: Recover 27 alternative-art texts using verified alias rows in the trimmed English source; keep original card IDs
decisions.datasPolicy: Use trimmed Chinese datas consistently for all generated locales; validate with production before release, no silent modern metadata merge
decisions.cleanupPolicy: Keep copied CDB bytes unchanged. At future build remove only the exact final desc line suffixes listed in per-locale suffixCleanupCandidates; preserve gameplay text and numeric occurrences elsewhere
decisions.encodingPolicy: English has existing U+FFFD characters; resolve by reviewed per-card text overrides before release, no blanket replacement
